notes.title: Lightbringers, beware – the darkness of the Deep has taken on a new shape!
notes.notes:
At Comic-Con Prague 2024, we were given the amazing chance to show our debut title Secret of the Deep to the public and to engage with you, our community, for the very first time. And since we didn’t want it to go to waste, we decided to take this wonderful opportunity to do something unique – to directly involve you in our development process by introducing you to our #BringTheLight initiative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961807/e888c50b21bb6300e0d6dd30c9f127dac611fdfb.png[/img]

Each of you had the opportunity to bring the light into the Deep and influence the game’s development by voting in our first community poll for a new Horde Leader – a powerful and dangerous enemy creature that you'll encounter in the treacherous darkness. And you have spoken! It is our great honor to announce that our next Horde leader will be…

…the [b]Smoldering Boulderbeast (Fire Golem)[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961807/1828b535ddaaa0cab118529be517c9a4958fe399.png[/img]

We are incredibly grateful to everyone who has chosen to not only follow our game’s development but also to actively participate in it. Dozens of you have shared your opinions online, and over a hundred of you have cast your votes after meeting with us in person at Comic-Con. Your enthusiasm for our game means the world to us. For this, we would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you.

But our adventure has only just begun! Many secrets still lurk in the Deep – and it is up to you, our brave Lightbringers, to bring the light into its darkness and unveil the horrors that hide within.

The next decision is just around the corner. Follow our social media to get all information on future community polls, and join our Discord for all updates on the implementation of your choices, as well as exclusive behind-the-scenes insights.

notes.title: UNCOVER THE SECRET OF THE DEEP IN OUR DEBUT TITLE!
notes.notes:
[i]As the fated hour draws near, the veil between worlds begins to thin, and the dark secrets now whisper to you. Will you summon the courage to heed their call?
[/i]

[previewyoutube=U27QqlXufMM;full][/previewyoutube]

We are honored to announce our first title, the single-player game Secret of the Deep (Early Access). Crafted with love and unwavering determination, our project aims to convey the passion and dedication poured into its every aspect, and we hope it will resonate with you. It’s an action adventure game with a unique blend of RPG elements, hack-n-slash combat, and resource management. All wrapped in a gripping fantasy story about uncovering the echoes of the past, battling darkness, and bringing hope to the hopeless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961807/a8a3c9dda089078aa3fa36349cfc17ae1e4e4ab4.jpg[/img]

You will take on the role of a hero who must repeatedly venture to a wretched place called the Deep, fight through hordes of enemies plagued by darkness and corruption, and collect resources that will aid him on his journey, but also help the people surviving in these forsaken lands. Managing collected resources and preparing for future battles will prove crucial. Enhance your equipment, and obtain magical abilities capable of piercing the dark abyss with light. Seek refuge from the oppressing horrors in the small, peaceful settlement of The Bailey, and help rebuild it while forming relationships with its residents. The sinister forces are trying to swallow them and you entirely, gnawing at your soul. 

Everything is shrouded in mystery, even yourself. Slash through this enigmatic veil engulfing all you see and try not to lose your sanity in the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961807/41cda9098bb9703a9e0add66b542de749cf73ced.jpg[/img]

[b]Secret of the Deep (Early Access version) will retail at 29.99 € on Steam in 2024[/b]. In the future, those who buy the game in Early Access now will receive the remaining content up to full release for free. By purchasing a supporter edition called [b]Keepers of the Deep for 39.99 €[/b], players will receive the base game, soundtrack, unique armor skin, in-game tombstone with the player’s nickname, and any future additional content after full release, without any further payment. This edition is limited only for preorders and these in-game bonuses won’t be available in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961807/e888c50b21bb6300e0d6dd30c9f127dac611fdfb.png[/img]

Esanti Games aims to fully immerse players in the Secret of the Deep story [b]even during the game’s development phase[/b]. This approach allows players to contribute to the creation of the in-game universe actively, allowing them to leave their mark on the game. [b]Through shared decisions[/b] made on one of the studio’s communication platforms or at events, Esanti Games will incorporate the resulting elements into various aspects of the game.

Bring light not only to the dark world of the Deep but to the game’s development. You have a unique opportunity to influence certain aspects of the gameplay content. You hold the light in your hands, and we will show you the power it can have.

[b]#BringTheLight[/b]

Thank you for bringing the light into the darkness and brace yourself to venture into the Deep.

If you want to try out [b]Secret of the Deep[/b], visit us at [b]Comic-Con Prague 2024 in Hall A at 5.4. - 7.4. 2024[/b]

[i]May the whispers guide your steps.[/i]
